create_dataset_audiovisual: create an AudioVisualDataset by calling CreateDataset with opt.model set to audioVisual
initialize_custom_dataloader: initialize a CustomDatasetDataLoader with opt to create a PyTorch DataLoader for the audioVisual dataset
load_data_dataloader: load data by calling load_data on CustomDatasetDataLoader to return the dataloader instance
iterate_dataset_batches: iterate over dataset batches using the CustomDatasetDataLoader iterator to yield batched data
get_dataset_length: get the total number of samples in the dataset by calling len on CustomDatasetDataLoader
